instruction.name: xvftintrp.w.d
instruction.description: For each 128-bit lane, convert double-precision floating point elements in the corresponding lane of `a` into the upper half and elements in `b` into the lower half, as signed 32-bit integers, rounding towards positive infinity.

experiments.name: dependent vector chain
experiments.notes: Register-to-register dependency chain. Source values are normal floats or small integers as appropriate.
